blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The low-pressure area (LPA) embedded in an intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) will bring rains over Metro Manila and other parts of the country on Saturday, Oct. 10. In its 4 a.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms may prevail over Metro Manila, Bicol Region, Calabarzon, Mimaropa, as well as the Visayas and Mindanao. This is due to the LPA enclosed within the ITCZ, it added. As of 3 a.m., the weather disturbance was located 410 kilometers (km) east of Catarman, Northern Samar, and within the […]...
